title: Kissed Snappy Filipino Pork Sisig
description: A romantic Filipino dish featuring chilli flakes and clay-pot-cooked pork, this sisig is a perfect blend of briny and snappy flavors, made satvik-friendly by using plant-based ingredients, the combination of pork, chili flakes, and calamansi makes it a perfect dish for any occasion.
instructions: Preheat the clay pot over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Add the pork face to the clay pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the diced onion to the clay pot and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the clay pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chilli flakes, salt, and black pepper to the clay pot and stir well.
Squeeze the calamansi juice over the pork mixture and stir well.
Cook the mixture for an additional 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the clay pot from the heat and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the sisig hot, garnished with diced onion and calamansi wedges.
